summary: Controller-condensed English transcription of the independent read-only reviewer final report. Review delivery completed; product acceptance failed. Snapshot 8cd6ec78527d732652e206bcf46da0365772c17b. No execution, mutations, external effects or subdelegation. Claims below distinguish static evidence from requested dynamic confirmation.

findings.claim: HIGH — The documented DisplayShiftY 2.4 to 3.4 mm edit shifts the display board but not the socket, male contacts or solder reserve; predicted 1 mm misregistration.

MEDIUM — FrameTop +0.4 leaves the ordinary inlay floor at 13.19 mm: depth grows to 0.8 mm and calculated ordinary backing falls to 0.6 mm, below the declared 0.8 mm minimum. Native section verification requested.
MEDIUM — All 36 BOM diodes are absent from the nominal installed mechanical model and its collision set. This is missing coverage, not a demonstrated collision.
MEDIUM — The current customization table says roof 1.2 mm and glass margin 0.4 mm, versus current parameters 1.4 and 0.1 mm.

recommendations: Confirm the documented CAD edits using isolated native probes, then repair shared parameter dependencies and current validation harnesses.
Retain unrouted PCB, integrated firmware, exact connector fit, retention, charging, BLE and power as unresolved product requirements.
Check the USB corridor against cases and broaden cap/screw coverage before claiming a collision; neither hypothesis was established in this static review.
